Accept easy contracts first: low risk me.tr: Önce kolay sözleşmeleri kabul et: düşük risk, istikrarlı nakit demek.
Accept easy contracts first: low risk me.de: Nimm zuerst einfache Aufträge an: Wenig Risiko bringt stetiges Geld.
Accept easy contracts first: low risk me.es: Acepta primero los contratos fáciles: poco riesgo significa dinero constante.
Accept easy contracts first: low risk me.fr: Accepte d’abord les contrats faciles : peu de risque, des gains réguliers.
Accept easy contracts first: low risk me.ja: まずは簡単な契約から。低リスクなら安定して稼げます。
Accept easy contracts first: low risk me.ko: 쉬운 계약부터 수락하세요. 위험이 낮으면 꾸준히 돈이 들어옵니다.
Accept easy contracts first: low risk me.pt: Aceite primeiro os contratos fáceis: pouco risco significa dinheiro constante.
Accept easy contracts first: low risk me.ru: Сначала берите простые контракты: низкий риск — стабильный доход.
Accept easy contracts first: low risk me.zh: 先接简单的合同：风险低，收入才稳定。

Highways are fast but risky; back roads.tr: Otoyollar hızlı ama risklidir; ara yollar yavaş ama güvenlidir.
Highways are fast but risky; back roads.de: Autobahnen sind schnell, aber riskant; Nebenstraßen sind langsam, aber sicher.
Highways are fast but risky; back roads.es: Las autopistas son rápidas pero arriesgadas; las carreteras secundarias son lentas pero seguras.
Highways are fast but risky; back roads.fr: Les autoroutes sont rapides mais risquées ; les petites routes sont lentes mais sûres.
Highways are fast but risky; back roads.ja: 高速道路は速いが危険、裏道は遅いが安全です。
Highways are fast but risky; back roads.ko: 고속도로는 빠르지만 위험하고, 뒷길은 느리지만 안전합니다.
Highways are fast but risky; back roads.pt: Rodovias são rápidas, mas arriscadas; estradas secundárias são lentas, mas seguras.
Highways are fast but risky; back roads.ru: Шоссе быстрые, но рискованные; объездные дороги медленные, но безопасные.
Highways are fast but risky; back roads.zh: 高速公路速度快但风险高，小路速度慢但更安全。

Heat adds risk but also better pay. Spre.tr: Isı riski artırır ama ödemeyi de yükseltir. İşlerini bölgelere yay.
Heat adds risk but also better pay. Spre.de: Hitze erhöht das Risiko, aber auch die Bezahlung. Verteile deine Arbeit auf mehrere Regionen.
Heat adds risk but also better pay. Spre.es: El calor aumenta el riesgo, pero también la paga. Reparte tu trabajo entre regiones.
Heat adds risk but also better pay. Spre.fr: La chaleur augmente le risque, mais aussi la paie. Répartis ton travail entre les régions.
Heat adds risk but also better pay. Spre.ja: 注目度はリスクを上げますが、報酬も増えます。仕事を複数の地域に分散しましょう。
Heat adds risk but also better pay. Spre.ko: 주목도는 위험을 높이지만 보수도 높여 줍니다. 여러 지역에 일을 나눠 맡기세요.
Heat adds risk but also better pay. Spre.pt: O calor aumenta o risco, mas também o pagamento. Distribua seu trabalho entre as regiões.
Heat adds risk but also better pay. Spre.ru: Внимание властей повышает риск, но и оплату. Распределяйте работу по регионам.
Heat adds risk but also better pay. Spre.zh: 热度会增加风险，但报酬也更高。把业务分散到不同地区。

Upgrade the engine to shorten trips, the.tr: Seyahat süresini kısaltmak için motoru, sonra daha çok araç için garajı geliştir.
Upgrade the engine to shorten trips, the.de: Rüste den Motor auf, um Fahrten zu verkürzen, und danach die Garage für mehr Fahrzeuge.
Upgrade the engine to shorten trips, the.es: Mejora el motor para acortar los viajes y después el garaje para tener más vehículos.
Upgrade the engine to shorten trips, the.fr: Améliore le moteur pour raccourcir les trajets, puis le garage pour plus de véhicules.
Upgrade the engine to shorten trips, the.ja: まずエンジンを強化して移動時間を短縮し、次にガレージを広げて車両を増やしましょう。
Upgrade the engine to shorten trips, the.ko: 엔진을 강화해 이동 시간을 줄이고, 그다음 차고를 넓혀 차량을 늘리세요.
Upgrade the engine to shorten trips, the.pt: Melhore o motor para encurtar as viagens e depois a garagem para ter mais veículos.
Upgrade the engine to shorten trips, the.ru: Улучшайте двигатель, чтобы сократить время в пути, а затем гараж — для новых машин.
Upgrade the engine to shorten trips, the.zh: 先升级引擎缩短行程，再扩建车库容纳更多车辆。

Good drivers cut risk. Hire the best you.tr: İyi şoförler riski azaltır. Bütçene uygun en iyisini işe al.
Good drivers cut risk. Hire the best you.de: Gute Fahrer senken das Risiko. Stelle die besten ein, die du dir leisten kannst.
Good drivers cut risk. Hire the best you.es: Los buenos conductores reducen el riesgo. Contrata a los mejores que puedas pagar.
Good drivers cut risk. Hire the best you.fr: De bons chauffeurs réduisent le risque. Engage les meilleurs que tu peux te payer.
Good drivers cut risk. Hire the best you.ja: 腕の良いドライバーはリスクを下げます。払える範囲で最高の人材を雇いましょう。
Good drivers cut risk. Hire the best you.ko: 좋은 운전사는 위험을 줄여 줍니다. 감당할 수 있는 최고의 사람을 고용하세요.
Good drivers cut risk. Hire the best you.pt: Bons motoristas reduzem o risco. Contrate os melhores que você puder pagar.
Good drivers cut risk. Hire the best you.ru: Хорошие водители снижают риск. Нанимайте лучших из тех, кто вам по карману.
Good drivers cut risk. Hire the best you.zh: 好司机能降低风险。在预算内尽量雇用最好的。

Automation keeps the empire working whil.tr: Otomasyon, sen yokken de imparatorluğun çalışmasını sağlar.
Automation keeps the empire working whil.de: Automatisierung hält dein Imperium am Laufen, während du weg bist.
Automation keeps the empire working whil.es: La automatización mantiene el imperio en marcha mientras no estás.
Automation keeps the empire working whil.fr: L’automatisation fait tourner l’empire pendant ton absence.
Automation keeps the empire working whil.ja: 自動化を進めれば、離れている間も帝国は稼働し続けます。
Automation keeps the empire working whil.ko: 자동화를 갖추면 자리를 비운 사이에도 제국이 계속 돌아갑니다.
Automation keeps the empire working whil.pt: A automação mantém o império funcionando enquanto você está fora.
Automation keeps the empire working whil.ru: Автоматизация продолжает работу империи, пока вас нет.
Automation keeps the empire working whil.zh: 自动化能让帝国在你离开时继续运转。
